title: Bench and planter
status: Detailed assembly instructions for the saved exterior model; no full functional building/game-ready claim
palette_policy: Use the new proposed role bindings in this pack. E/T/V are sourced dirt/oak candidates; Q is dry glass. Source models and their earlier unassigned-role labels remain preserved.
placement_rule: Eight-square landscape furniture bay; planting material unassigned.

stages.title: Base, floor and ground-level frame / civil Y-1..+0
actions: Set out the full footprint and place only the base/floor and ground-frame cells assigned to this step. Keep model openings and stair apertures empty.

Check each slab symbol: s occupies the lower half (placed meta0); S occupies the upper half (placed meta8). Both consume ordinary stone slab inventory0. Keep half-steps separate; do not make double slabs.

In the layer viewer select this step, then work through its occupied Y levels. Bright cells belong to this step; muted cells show the complete model for context. A dot or empty square is not an excavation instruction.

stages.title: Ascending structural lift / civil Y+1..+1
actions: Build this structural lift one horizontal layer at a time, lowest first. Place the dark fields/supports and pale frame at their separate coordinates; include roof-deck cells only where listed. Do not flatten stepped ribs or join separated facade planes into one solid wall.

In the layer viewer select this step, then work through its occupied Y levels. Bright cells belong to this step; muted cells show the complete model for context. A dot or empty square is not an excavation instruction.

stages.title: Planting-bed dirt / civil Y+0..+0
actions: Fill only E positions with dirt0 inside the modeled beds. Do not backfill open paths, bench gaps or the whole planter envelope.

In the layer viewer select this step, then work through its occupied Y levels. Bright cells belong to this step; muted cells show the complete model for context. A dot or empty square is not an excavation instruction.

stages.title: Player-placed oak foliage / civil Y+1..+2
actions: Place V using oak leaf inventory0; the inspected vanilla ItemLeaves path adds persistence flag4. Match every foliage cell, then inspect the actual placed leaves in the target game. No growth or crop behavior is claimed.

In the layer viewer select this step, then work through its occupied Y levels. Bright cells belong to this step; muted cells show the complete model for context. A dot or empty square is not an excavation instruction.
